run_single_language_asr_inference: run ASR inference for a single language using fairseq MMS model with viterbi decoding
reorder_decode_hypotheses: reorder ASR hypothesis lines by extracting and sorting embedded numeric indices
run_asr_with_fairseq_cli: run the fairseq speech recognition inference pipeline for a specified language and model path
reorder_asr_output_files: reorder hypo.word and asr_score output files by their embedded sample indices
run_mms_asr_for_language: run multilingual speech recognition for a single language with automatic language code mapping
